Dashboard

Choose the information displayed to customers.

Request list fields

Show up to three additional customer-visible request fields in Portal+'s request list. Key, summary, request type and status are always available.

Portal+ only offers fields exposed as visible on JSM customer request forms.

Service categories

Group request types into customer-friendly quick-action areas. Category order here is the order customers see.

A request type can appear in more than one category. Empty categories are hidden from customers.

Audience

Leave all organizations unselected to show Portal+ to everyone who already has JSM access. Select organizations to show Portal+ only to customers who belong to at least one selected JSM organization.

Use Ctrl/Cmd to select more than one organization. Jira permissions still control which requests each customer can access.

Status mapping

Map your customer-facing statuses into Portal+'s consistent dashboard states.

Portal+ does not assume every Jira site uses the same workflow status names.
